# ULiège Research & Innovation

> > Official research portal of the University of Liège (ULiège), showcasing cutting-edge academic research, scientific publications, and innovation across artificial intelligence, health sciences, and humanities.

The platform serves as the central hub for ULiège's research activities, providing access to the ORBi institutional repository and highlighting breakthrough studies in machine learning, neuromodulation, historical epidemiology, and COVID-19 impact studies. The site features work from leading researchers including Nicolas Vecoven, Antoine Wehenkel, Damien Ernst, and Guillaume Drion.

## Key Topics

- ULiège (Université de Liège / University of Liège)
- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- Neuromodulation & Neural Networks
- Synaptic Plasticity
- COVID-19 Research
- ORBi Institutional Repository
- Historical Epidemiology
- Ancient Greek & Roman Medicine
- Papyrology
- Smart City Institute
- Walloon Municipalities
- PLOS ONE Publications
- AI Algorithms
- Medical History

## Research Portal & Repository

- [Recherche & Innovation](https://recherche.uliege.be/): ULiège Research & Innovation homepage with ORBi repository access

## Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Research

- [ULiège researchers create a new method of Artificial Intelligence](https://www.recherche.uliege.be/cms/c_11524260/en/uliege-researchers-create-a-new-method-of-artificial-intelligence): ULiège AI research on neuromodulation-based neural networks in PLOS ONE

## Health & Epidemiology Studies

- [Épidémies et remèdes dans l'histoire](https://www.recherche.uliege.be/cms/c_11819087/en/epidemies-et-remedes-dans-l-histoire): Historical perspectives on epidemics and remedies by ULiège historians
- [COVID-19 : Quel impact sur nos communes ?](https://www.recherche.uliege.be/cms/c_12139232/fr/covid-19-quel-impact-sur-nos-communes): Smart City Institute survey on COVID-19 impact on Walloon municipalities
